slug: 2025-05-20 African nations making digital ID gains in the face of common challenges (ID4Africa 2025)

systems.system: Integrated System of Population Management and Secured Titles (SIGPTS)
systems.owner: National Agency for the Population Register and Secure Titles (ANRPTS)
systems.tiers: national ID system put in place in 2020, integrating all government structures involved in issuing ID documents; more than 94 per cent of the population enrolled for national ID, per the ANRPTS director at ID4Africa, May 2025

digital ID and digital-government platform launched in 2023; 70 per cent of passport requests made through it and more than 622,000 document extracts processed in the year, per the ANRPTS director, May 2025

note: The extract describes SIGPTS as the system for enrolling the population for national ID and issuing ID documents, and Houwiyeti as a remote request platform; it does not say births or deaths are registered in either.
